name: Kashinaga Kazuto
source:
Akina's childhood friend, a calm person who is kind to everyone.
He rarely gets mad.
He's often covering for Akina when he can't read the mood and says weird things.
He's part of the literary club and his hobby is reading and writing novels.
He doesn't have much stamina and always gets worn out quickly.
translation:
